summary.t: Big, long, and covered in stars.

text.t:
The largest pieces in the range — up to 71 cm long. There is the long-necked one in deep blue, speckled with light, and the plated one in green.

They are big on purpose: they live on the floor against a wall and light a whole room.

options.power.help.t: Batteries are not included. The mains version comes with a remote: on, off, dimmer, timer and a slow pulse.

options.engraving.help.t: A name, a date or a short phrase, burned into the wood. Leave it empty if you would rather not.
